To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we propose a novel data structure, called the Filtered Simplex Tree, that represents the entire filtration of a simplical complex, that it supports efficient queries, and that its size is linear in the number of simplices of the simplicial complex.

• A filtration over a complex can be compactly represented by a set of pointers to the simplices of its boundary, and that • The boundary simplices can be stored in a compact data structure called the Simplex Tree, which can also be constructed in O(|K| log |K|) time

(i) the Simplex Tree data structure can be extended to represent the filtration of the simplicial complex; and (ii) the extended data structure can be used to answer queries in the same time as answering the same query in the original data structure, and in the worst case, the size of the extended data structure is linear in the size of the simplicical complex.
In summary, our research is concerned with

finding an efficient representation of the filtration of a complex, which is also compact, and can support efficient queries such as finding the simplices of a given dimension, or the number of simplices in the filtration.
finding efficient ways of representing and storing filtrations of simplicial complexes.

the problem of finding an efficient representation for filtrations of simplicial complexes that can support various types of queries, such as finding all the simplices with a given index in the filtration, finding the index of a given simplex in the filtration, and finding the index of the first or last occurrence of a simplex in the filtration.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the simplex tree is the best data structure for representing simplicial complexes.
the Simplex Tree is a better data structure for simplicial complexes than any other data structure.

, in the absence of a good representation for simplicial complexes that can be used as a basis for a filtration, we have to rely on a data structure that is able to store the simplices of a complex and their relationships, and that can also support efficient queries.
